items.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
items.content: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
items.content: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

items.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
items.content: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

items.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
items.content: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

items.title: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect
items.content: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.

items.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
items.content: Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.

items.title: BTC price eyes $73K amid Nvidia volatility: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.content: Bitcoin price action fell to its lowest levels since mid-August as Nvidia reports added to sell-side pressure across stock-market futures.

items.title: Binance, Tether and Trump crypto firms face Senate records deadline
items.content: Sen. Richard Blumenthal asked four crypto firms to start sending records by Nov. 30 and warned of further action if they miss the Jan. 4 deadline.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.3B in biggest weekly outflow since late June
items.content: Investors pulled a net $1.21 billion from BlackRock’s IBIT last week as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US technology stocks sold off.

items.title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
items.content: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

items.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
items.content: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

items.title: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest
items.content: Vitalik Buterin wants Ethereum to embrace a store of value narrative, upsetting Bitcoin maxis. The crypto industry faces an uncertain future following the US elections.

items.title: Binance France emails announce closure of its users’ accounts on Dec. 31
items.content: Any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, company says.

items.title: Amsterdam protesters break into Microsoft data center construction site: Report
items.content: Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing during the protest.

items.title: Binance’s  finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says
items.content: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.

items.title: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto
items.content: Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard.

items.title: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
items.content: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.

items.title: US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties
items.content: US  also offers as much as $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program.

items.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
items.content: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

items.title: Nvidia may face a more hostile post-election Washington: Report
items.content: CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with President Donald Trump probably won’t save the company from a more adversarial Washington, Semafor says.

items.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
items.content: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

items.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
items.content: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

items.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
items.content: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

items.title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
items.content: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

items.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
items.content: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
items.content: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

items.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
items.content: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.

items.title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
items.content: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.

items.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.content: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.
